clues: This town lies in southern Spain, in the heart of a rich vegetable garden plain. It sits a short way inland from the nearest beaches.
Winter months here sit near sixteen degrees. In July and August, the heat climbs to twenty eight.
Its main church was built in the seventeen hundreds. It holds fine works by Salcillo and Roque Lopez.
More than fifteen hundred horses are shown here each year. They take part in all sorts of games and fun activities.
In mid September, folks honor their patron saint. They hold a carriage parade, a wild cow run, and a grand procession.
